extracted.name: Orange Buttermilk Salad
extracted.description: A refreshing chilled salad with orange gelatin, pineapple, buttermilk, and whipped topping.
ingredient_lines: 1 (8 ounce) container frozen whipped topping, thawed
instruction_lines: Mix pineapple and sugar together in a medium saucepan, and bring to a low boil, stirring occasionally. Stir in gelatin until completely dissolved, remove from heat, and cool to room temperature. Add buttermilk, and refrigerate 1 hour, or until partially set.
Gently fold in whipped topping. Pour mixture into a lightly oiled gelatin mold. Refrigerate 8 hours, or until completely set.
